nodes.description: Constructor that seeds the eth/reb and usdc/eth cumulative price and timestamp state variables from the Uniswap V2 pairs.
External state-mutating function that gates on a minimum elapsed PERIOD, writes lastUpdate, and refreshes all cumulative price/timestamp state variables.
Public view function computing the average REB/ETH price from deltas of the eth-reb pair cumulative prices over elapsed block time.
Public view function computing the average USDC/ETH price from deltas of the usdc-eth pair cumulative prices over elapsed block time.
IOracle entry point returning the final REB price in USD derived from the REB/ETH and USDC/ETH average rates.
Timestamp of the last successful oracle update; used as the minuend in the unchecked timeElapsed subtraction and rewritten in update().
Stored eth-reb pair price0CumulativeLast snapshot, updated in constructor and update().
Stored eth-reb pair price1CumulativeLast snapshot, subtracted from the live cumulative price in getRebEthRate().
Stored eth-reb pair reserve timestamp snapshot, used as the divisor operand in the average price computation.
Stored usdc-eth pair price0CumulativeLast snapshot, updated in constructor and update().
Stored usdc-eth pair price1CumulativeLast snapshot, refreshed in update().
Stored usdc-eth pair reserve timestamp snapshot, used in the elapsed-time divisor.
Constant 6 hour minimum interval enforced by the update() time gate.
Miner/validator-influenceable block timestamp used for update gating and for elapsed-time math in the price oracle.
External calls to IUniswapV2Pair price0CumulativeLast(), price1CumulativeLast() and getReserves() returning untrusted oracle data.
Unchecked 0.6.x subtraction timeElapsed = lastUpdate - timeStamp that underflows/reverts when the stored timestamp is in the future relative to block.timestamp.
Unchecked subtraction of stored vs live cumulative prices divided by (blockTimestamp - storedTimestamp): underflow and division-by-zero risk when no time has elapsed since the snapshot.
Local cache of block.timestamp inside update().
Local result of lastUpdate - timeStamp used by the PERIOD require.
Local final price computed as (rebEthAverage * 1e18) / usdcEthAverage and returned by getData().

edges.reason: Constructor queries the Uniswap V2 pairs' cumulative price and reserve getters during deployment.
Constructor assigns the eth-reb price0CumulativeLast return value into ethRebPrice0CumulativeLast.
Constructor assigns the eth-reb reserve blockTimestampLast into ethRebBlockTimestampLast.
Constructor assigns the usdc-eth price0CumulativeLast return value into usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast.
Constructor assigns the usdc-eth reserve blockTimestampLast into usdcEthBlockTimestampLast.
update() reads block.timestamp to derive the elapsed time used by the update-period guard.
block.timestamp flows into update()'s timeElapsed computation, giving miners influence over whether the update gate passes.
timeStamp local is assigned block.timestamp.
timeStamp is the subtrahend of the unchecked lastUpdate - timeStamp subtraction.
lastUpdate is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction; if lastUpdate > block.timestamp the operation underflows and reverts.
update() reads lastUpdate for the period check and later overwrites it with the current timestamp.
update() writes lastUpdate = timeStamp, advancing the oracle update window.
PERIOD constant is consumed by the require(timeElapsed > PERIOD) access gate in update().
timeElapsed local receives the result of the unchecked lastUpdate - timeStamp subtraction.
update() calls getRebEthRate() to refresh the eth-reb snapshots.
update() calls getUsdcEthRate() to refresh the usdc-eth snapshots.
update() stores the returned price0Cumulative into ethRebPrice0CumulativeLast.
update() stores the returned blockTimestamp into ethRebBlockTimestampLast.
update() stores the returned price0Cumulative into usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast.
update() stores the returned blockTimestamp into usdcEthBlockTimestampLast.
getRebEthRate() calls UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices on the eth-reb pair, triggering external getter calls.
External pair cumulative prices and reserves are returned into getRebEthRate()'s computation.
block.timestamp (wrapped to uint32) is used as the current timestamp in the eth-reb cumulative price math.
ethRebBlockTimestampLast is subtracted from the current block timestamp to form the divisor of the average price division.
ethRebPrice1CumulativeLast is subtracted from the live cumulative value; an oracle-advanced state can underflow in 0.6.x.
getRebEthRate() performs the unchecked delta subtraction and division that may underflow or divide by zero.
getRebEthRate() reads ethRebBlockTimestampLast as the snapshot timestamp baseline.
getRebEthRate() reads ethRebPrice1CumulativeLast as the stored cumulative price baseline.
getUsdcEthRate() calls currentCumulativePrices on the usdc-eth pair, triggering external getter calls.
External pair cumulative prices and reserves are returned into getUsdcEthRate()'s computation.
block.timestamp feeds the elapsed-time divisor in the usdc-eth average price computation.
getUsdcEthRate() repeats the unchecked delta subtraction and division pattern that can underflow or divide by zero.
getUsdcEthRate() reads usdcEthPrice0CumulativeLast as the baseline for the usdc-eth delta.
getData() calls getRebEthRate() to obtain the REB/ETH average.
getData() calls getUsdcEthRate() to obtain the USDC/ETH average.
The REB/ETH average returned by getRebEthRate() is used as the numerator input in getData().
The USDC/ETH average returned by getUsdcEthRate() is used as the denominator input in getData().
getData() computes answer = rebEthAverage * 1e18 / usdcEthAverage, which divides by zero if the USDC average is 0.

normalization_plan.reason: update::timeStamp is only a temporary alias of block.timestamp read inside update(); merge it into the update() function node.
update::timeElapsed exists solely as the result of the unchecked lastUpdate - timeStamp subtraction; merge it into that unsafe operation node.
getData::answer is the local return value computed and returned by getData(); merge it into the getData() function node.
